definitions.curvature: 501 identical reference ridge UV samples, projected coordinates x=screenX*(W/H), y=screenY, central difference |x'y''-y'x''|/(x'^2+y'^2)^(3/2); units 1/screen-height; all 499 interior samples, without cropping; Grid is settled to load=1 before both static and loaded ridge traces.
definitions.deltaSecond: Central second differences of loaded minus rest projected XY; Euclidean norm, screen-height units per index squared; 499 interior samples
definitions.jacobian: 81x81 grid of reference screen UV coordinates x,y in [.02,.98]; physical XY=[sample.x*W/H,(sample.y-.5)/scaleY+.5]. Finite difference epsilon=.0001 screen-height. Singular values dimensionless.
definitions.hessian: Added sag sample(loaded).z-sample(rest).z; physical XY derivatives using epsilon=.001 screen-height; contact neighbourhood |x-hitX|<=.12, |y-hitY|<=.12. Frobenius Hessian norm, sag units /screen-height squared.

pc-smooth.note: Browser real-time recording. CPU dt capped 1/30; low FPS can slow simulation in wall time. Submit CPU does not measure GPU.

cpuGpuAgreement.limitation: GPU render readback positions/derivatives were not directly measured; no GPU timing claim
